intent: Write the test for SinkEventBroadcast (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/eventlog/infrastructure/SinkEventBroadcast.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. EventBroadcast implemented with a Reactor Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(bufferCapacity, false) sink, capacity from TelemetryProperties. publish serializes emissions (synchronized) and returns true only when tryEmitNext succeeds; any other emit result returns false (never throws, never blocks). stream returns sink.asFlux(). TEST DUTIES: Assert subscribers receive published records in order, publish returns true while capacity remains, and returns false once the bounded buffer is full with no subscriber.

methods.semantics: true accepted; false refused (overflow) and counted by the caller in telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=broadcast}
